description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹基本會計學原則及觀念，主要包括：應收帳款、存貨、長期性資產取得及折舊、公司會計、投資、負債、現金流量表及財務報表分析。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces basic accounting principle and concepts. The main topics include receivable, inventory, plant assets acquisition and depreciation, corporate accounting, investment, liabilities, statement of cash flows and financial statements analysis。

targets.describe_ch: 能認識會計學(二)涵蓋的主要內容及描述現代企業的財務報表及其限制。
targets.describe_en: Knowledge for the content of Accounting II and modern business financial statements and their limitations.

targets.describe_ch: 能理解可應用會計學原理的情況。
targets.describe_en: Comprehension for the application accounting principle situation.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Reminder:提醒

(1) Attend class punctually, and avoid behaviors such as chatting that may disrupt others during class. 請準時到課，避免在課堂上聊天與任何可能干擾他人的行為。

(2) Mutual care, encouragement, and respect between instructors and students are expected and upheld. 師生間應互相關懷、鼓勵與尊重。

(3) Follow the school's regulations when requesting leave. 請假時請遵守學校相關規定。

(4) Attendance will be based on being physically present at roll call.點名時到場即視為出席。

(5) Active participation in discussions is encouraged.鼓勵積極參與課堂討論。

(6) Students are not permitted to use mobile phones or tablet devices for purposes unrelated to this course during class sessions.課堂上，學生不得將手機或平板電腦用於與本課程無關的用途。

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
期望學生在學習評量、班上互動和課程結束後能展示學術誠信，包括不抄襲、不作弊並遵守學校和課程的相關規範。違反學術誠信的學生將面臨學校和課程規定的相應處分，可能包括但不限於失去評分資格、學科警告或更嚴重的學校紀律處分。希望學生能遵守學術誠信，以確保教學品質和個人成長。 
 
學習必須以誠信為基礎，任何學生企圖將自己未製作的作品，作為自己的作品，此行為是為不誠實行為。在作業、測驗或考試中作弊或抄襲的學生或協助他人的行為，該次成績以零分計，若是累犯，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法提送。
  • 考核時如果您抄襲他人的答案、或交作業時您交出全部或部分由他人撰寫的論文或作業，則被視為作弊。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
• ◎Academic Integrity  學術誠信
    Per university policy, students shall not plagiarize, cheat, or falsify or misuse academic records. Students are expected to adhere to University policy on cheating and plagiarism in all courses. The minimum penalty for a first offense is a zero on the assignment on which the offense occurred. If the offense is considered severe or the student has other academic offenses on their record, more serious penalties, up to suspension from the university may be imposed.
    Plagiarism and cheating are serious breaches of academic conduct. When students submit work purporting to be their own, but which in any way borrows ideas, organization, wording or anything else from another source without appropriate acknowledgement of the fact, the students are guilty of plagiarism. Plagiarism includes reproducing someone else’s work, whether it be a published article, chapter of a book, a paper from a friend or some file, or something similar to this. Plagiarism includes the practice of employing or allowing another person to alter or revise the work which a student submits as his/her own, whoever that other person may be.
  •  根據大學規定，學生不得抄襲、作弊、偽造或濫用學術記錄。學生在所有課程中均須遵守大學關於作弊和抄襲的政策。初犯的最低處罰是該項違規作業得零分。如果違規行為性質嚴重，或學生有其他學術違規記錄，則可能受到更嚴厲的處罰，直到被大學停學。 抄襲和作弊是嚴重的學術不當行為。學生提交的作品，如果聲稱是自己的原創作品，但其中以任何方式借鑒了其他來源的觀點、結構、措辭或其他任何內容，且未適當註明出處，則構成抄襲。抄襲包括複製他人的作品，無論是已出版的文章、書籍章節、朋友的論文或文件，或是類似內容。剽竊包括僱用或允許他人更改或修改學生提交的、作為自己作品的作品的行為，無論該他人是誰。
 
  • ◎Disclaimer 免責聲明
    All policies discussed herein are subject to the official University Regulations. If there is a discrepancy between and of our policies and the University policies, the official policies shall reign. Also, we reserve the right to modify any part of this syllabus to your advantage during the semester after giving adequate notice of such changes (e.g. extend due dates).
  • 本文所討論的所有政策均受大學官方規章制度約束。如我們的政策與大學政策有任何衝突，以大學官方政策為準。此外，我們保留在學期中對本課程大綱的任何部分進行修改的權利，但會提前充分通知您（例如，延長截止日期）。

integrity.ais_meno:
期望學生在學習評量、班上互動和課程結束後能展示學術誠信，包括不抄襲、不作弊並遵守學校和課程的相關規範。違反學術誠信的學生將面臨學校和課程規定的相應處分，可能包括但不限於失去評分資格、學科警告或更嚴重的學校紀律處分。希望學生能遵守學術誠信，以確保教學品質和個人成長。 
 
學習必須以誠信為基礎，任何學生企圖將自己未製作的作品，作為自己的作品，此行為是為不誠實行為。在作業、測驗或考試中作弊或抄襲的學生或協助他人的行為，該次成績以零分計，若是累犯，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法提送。
  • 考核時如果您抄襲他人的答案、或交作業時您交出全部或部分由他人撰寫的論文或作業，則被視為作弊。
integrity.ais_meno_en:
• ◎Academic Integrity  學術誠信
    Per university policy, students shall not plagiarize, cheat, or falsify or misuse academic records. Students are expected to adhere to University policy on cheating and plagiarism in all courses. The minimum penalty for a first offense is a zero on the assignment on which the offense occurred. If the offense is considered severe or the student has other academic offenses on their record, more serious penalties, up to suspension from the university may be imposed.
    Plagiarism and cheating are serious breaches of academic conduct. When students submit work purporting to be their own, but which in any way borrows ideas, organization, wording or anything else from another source without appropriate acknowledgement of the fact, the students are guilty of plagiarism. Plagiarism includes reproducing someone else’s work, whether it be a published article, chapter of a book, a paper from a friend or some file, or something similar to this. Plagiarism includes the practice of employing or allowing another person to alter or revise the work which a student submits as his/her own, whoever that other person may be.
  •  根據大學規定，學生不得抄襲、作弊、偽造或濫用學術記錄。學生在所有課程中均須遵守大學關於作弊和抄襲的政策。初犯的最低處罰是該項違規作業得零分。如果違規行為性質嚴重，或學生有其他學術違規記錄，則可能受到更嚴厲的處罰，直到被大學停學。 抄襲和作弊是嚴重的學術不當行為。學生提交的作品，如果聲稱是自己的原創作品，但其中以任何方式借鑒了其他來源的觀點、結構、措辭或其他任何內容，且未適當註明出處，則構成抄襲。抄襲包括複製他人的作品，無論是已出版的文章、書籍章節、朋友的論文或文件，或是類似內容。剽竊包括僱用或允許他人更改或修改學生提交的、作為自己作品的作品的行為，無論該他人是誰。
 
  • ◎Disclaimer 免責聲明
    All policies discussed herein are subject to the official University Regulations. If there is a discrepancy between and of our policies and the University policies, the official policies shall reign. Also, we reserve the right to modify any part of this syllabus to your advantage during the semester after giving adequate notice of such changes (e.g. extend due dates).
  • 本文所討論的所有政策均受大學官方規章制度約束。如我們的政策與大學政策有任何衝突，以大學官方政策為準。此外，我們保留在學期中對本課程大綱的任何部分進行修改的權利，但會提前充分通知您（例如，延長截止日期）。
